mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (0.15% as of t-1mo) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 500 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 330,000 indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 330000 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level below 100 (relative to 2017 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 212.5 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 212.5 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment level above 132,000 (thousands) signals strong labor market growth, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 132000 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (0.15% as of t-1mo) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production below 100 (indicating manufacturing contraction) and unemployment above 8.5% (indicating labor market weakness) signal a severe economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 8.5 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).
